name: Nandini River Basin
significance: Holy river born from the Western Ghats (Kanakachala), surrounding Kateel temple island; venue of divine Avabhritha baths.

name: Netravati & Phalguni (Gurupura) Estuary
significance: Major twin river systems of Tulunadu, merging at Bengre before meeting the Arabian Sea; water source for Dharmasthala and Polali.

name: Kumaradhara River
significance: Perennial alpine river flowing through dense rainforests at the base of Kumara Parvatha peak; purifying waters for Sarpa Samskara.

name: Aghanashini Estuary
significance: One of India’s last pristine undammed estuaries, flowing past Gokarna with dense sacred mangrove groves.

name: Nagabanas (Evergreen Serpent Groves)
significance: Ancient undisturbed forest patches housing endemic flora (Myristica swamps, wild cinnamon, Hopea parviflora) protected by religious taboos against tree-felling.

name: Kaanu & Devarakadus (Sacred Spirit Groves)
significance: Communal virgin forest sanctuaries dedicated to territorial Daivas and forest spirits.
